# StretchMetal

> B2B metal fabrication workshop in Częstochowa, Poland — the metal business
> unit of the Belgian Stretchgroup (stretch-ceiling manufacturer, brands
> STRETCH / stretchplafond.be and Stretch Sufit / altodesign.pl). The workshop
> was built for the group's own production of steel substructures and now also
> serves external clients across Poland and the EU.

Languages: Polish (default, at /) and English (under /en).

## Services

- Welding (MIG/MAG + TIG; mild steel, stainless, aluminium): /uslugi/spawanie · /en/services/welding
- Laser cutting of sheet metal: /uslugi/ciecie-laserowe · /en/services/laser-cutting
- CNC machining (milling + turning): /uslugi/obrobka-cnc · /en/services/cnc-machining
- Powder coating (full RAL): /uslugi/malowanie-proszkowe · /en/services/powder-coating
- Technical design & 2D/3D documentation: /uslugi/projektowanie · /en/services/design-engineering
- Complete custom steel structures: /uslugi/konstrukcje-stalowe · /en/services/steel-structures

## How to get a quote

Send a technical drawing (DXF, DWG, STEP, IGES, PDF or ZIP, up to 15 MB)
through the quote form: /wycena (PL) or /en/quote (EN). Quotes are answered
within 48 business hours with a price and a binding lead time. NDA available
on request. Languages spoken: Polish, English, Dutch.

## Key facts

- Location: ul. Legionów 59, 42-200 Częstochowa, Poland (Silesian steel
  region, next to the A1 motorway; 1–2 day trucking to Germany/Benelux).
- Contact: info@stretchmetal.pl · +48 730 700 333 · Mon–Fri 08:00–16:00.
- Deliveries: across the EU.
- The workshop does NOT claim EN 1090 / ISO 3834 / ISO 9001 certification.
  Structures requiring EN 1090 CE marking are referred to certified
  fabricators.
